title: afc80980/E2: Rayon SoA chunks multithread for C4/C5 batch field ops
description:
## Current

The SoA scaffolding from C4/C5 is single-threaded.

## Fix

V10: introduce a new `crates/gf2-core/src/compute/field.rs` module that drives rayon-parallel iteration over SoA chunks (Karatsuba steps within a chunk are SIMD-batched per C4/C5).

## Pre-flight check

Same as E1. If C4/C5 single-thread is memory-bound at large batch sizes, multi-thread will not help — abort.

## Per-kernel execution protocol

Same as E1.

## Depends on

C4, C5.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. single-threaded SoA path.
- [hard] Strong-scaling efficiency ≥ 70% at 4 threads.
- [aspirational] ≥3× over the post-C4/C5 single-thread baseline at 4 threads, design batch size.
